reader_summary.headline: In episodes one and two of Hashpower, we explored blockchain technology and cryptocurrency investing.
reader_summary.overview: In episodes one and two of Hashpower, we explored blockchain technology and cryptocurrency investing. In this episode, we discussed the current and potential future states of the crypto world. We cover new forms of cooperation, regulation, security and storage, and why blockchains allow systems to evolve at such a rapid pace.

thesis: The episode discusses the evolution of cryptocurrency funding from traditional Initial Coin Offerings (ICOs) involving external holding companies to Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs), where token holders directly control funds via smart contracts. It highlights that while ICOs currently allow teams to raise capital for development, the future trend involves moving toward native blockchain financial products and governance mechanisms that eliminate the need for non-blockchain real-world entities.
